items.paraphrase: Fixed v1, authors Chen/Chewi/Lu/Zhang, arXiv perpetual non-exclusive license. No new public bulk source copying.
V is C2 and 0<alpha<=beta; two positivity/order binders plus smoothness.
Everywhere alpha I <= Hess V <= beta I, one original Hessian sandwich binder.
Scale 0<eta<=1/beta; retain positive eta and beta eta<=1. Together exactly six analytic binders.
Center c=y-eta gradV(r), gradient remainder h_r(x)=gradV(x)-gradV(r).
Work at deterministic fixed y,r; phase z0=(x0,p0). No random-state substitution.
Actual rate sqrt(eta) times positive part of pairing p,h_r(x).
Actual harmonic flow with c, sqrt(eta), reciprocal sqrt(eta), sin and cos; continuous at0 and Phi0=id.
Actual phase reflection; R0=id, finite wait update only.
Bounce may be discontinuous where normal vanishes; no bounce continuity is used in proposed test limit.
Independent Exp1 clocks, source E1 starts initial live phase at T0=0. Index0 implementation corresponds to source E_(n+1).
Integrated-hazard first threshold hit, empty-hit wait infinity.
Finite wait adds to time and applies bounce at endpoint; no flow evaluation at infinity.
Half-open finite arcs; infinite next wait leaves final live arc at every finite elapsed time, stopped dummy is auxiliary.
Source direct Exp mean1 SLLN establishes nonaccumulation; memorylessness/Markov continuation is separate. Existing actual parents may realize an explicit sufficient SLLN alternative.
Source joint Borel recursion and almost-sure terminal limit; source failed-limit zero vs actual uncovered-z0 convention is an explicit exceptional adapter.
Source C_c test flow converges to identity; first-event control is the immediate pointwise ingredient of later strong continuity.
First-event probability 1-exp(-Lambda_t) tends to0. Phase-flow defect is a subset, not necessarily the same event.
Before integrating a squared pointwise operator difference over phase, one must establish pointwise expectation convergence. C_c is continuous and bounded in finite phase dimension.
DCT over initial phase requires its measurable probability measure, pointwise convergence and an integrable bound. This is distinct from stochastic convergence over clock samples.
Source obtains L2 contraction from invariance plus Jensen, which the proposed fixed-state expectation edge neither assumes nor proves.
Extension from C_c to all L2 uses density plus an already established contractive operator family.
Transition operators are introduced for the process of Prop3.1. Markov/semigroup/adjoint claims cannot follow from expectation convergence at0.
nu_eta,y is exact conditional Gibbs position law times Gaussian momentum. No nu invariance premise is needed to integrate over clocks at fixed z0.
Source path reversal supplies invariance before contraction; do not import its conclusion from the word transition.
Full jump-number/path expansion and Tonelli change-of-variables are separate; first-wait split does not prove that expansion.
General bounded continuous real test is an explicit conservative extension of source C_c pointwise ingredient; boundedness is a property of test, not an added potential/trajectory assumption.

Actual82 defect bound can be integrated: bounded test discrepancy relative to deterministic free flow is at most 2M times defect probability. Produces genuine expectation estimate, no supplied estimate premise.

Actual82 convergence in probability plus local continuity and uniform boundedness gives expected absolute discrepancy convergence by epsilon/delta split. No a.s. convergence or samplewise DCT is inferred.
Ideal exact-reference H_y averaging is separate; this fixed-reference clock expectation does not claim an implemented reference sampler or random-alltime law.
